title: Retail stock availability
bodyMd:
Each observation checks one listed product at one scheduled time. Available observations are a subset of checks, not a count of distinct products.

| Category | Stock checks | Available observations |
|---|---:|---:|
| Convenience | 100 | 85 |
| Standard | 200 | 160 |
| Large | 300 | 270 |
